senses.gloss: f. (תָּקַּע) blowing the Shofar; esp. t’ḳiʿah, a succession of connected notes (v. שֶׁבֶר I).
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 34a:10">R. Hash. 34ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="U00176"><he>שֶׁבֶר</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 30a:7">Ib. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>תְּקִיעַת ר״ה ויובל</he> blowing on the New Year’s day and in announcing the jubilee.
Ib. IV, 9 (33ᵇ) שיעור ת׳ וכ׳ (not תקיעות) the value of a t’ḳiʿah is equal to the length of three t’ruʿoth; a. fr.—Pl. תְּקִיעוֹת.

Ib. סרר ת׳ שלש וכ׳ the order of the blowing of the Shofar is this: three soundings, each consisting of three tunes (t’ḳiʿah, t’ruʿah, t’ḳiʿah). Ib. 34ᵃ שתי ת׳ לכל אחת ואחת two t’ḳiʿoth for each sounding; שלש תרועות ושש ת׳ וכ׳ three t’ruʿoth and six t’ḳiʿoth are sounded on the New Year’s day. Ib.ᵇ top תשע ת׳ בתשע וכ׳ if one sounded the nine tunes within nine hours during the day; a. fr.
